payload.notes: Split into 4 stacked PRs (main -> #23 -> #24 -> #25 -> #26, each verified in isolation with a clean pnpm typecheck/test), the same pattern E3-T01 used, since this ticket's full diff (~1000 lines incl. lockfile) is well over the ~400-line review ceiling. #23: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_MODEL in env.ts (verified claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 against Anthropic's current model docs), the ChatClient port, llmFailedError. #24: anthropicChatClient.ts (the only module that knows @langchain/anthropic exists) and providerRegistry.ts's getChatClient, both adding @langchain/anthropic@^1.5.9. #25: promptBuilder.ts's pure prompt/context helpers. #26 (completes the ticket): ragGraph.service.ts -- the one compiled LangGraph StateGraph (ADR-14) with exactly two nodes (retrieve, generate) and a conditional edge to END on zero relevant chunks (no LLM call at all) -- plus chat.service.ts's answerQuestion(sessionId, question) public entry point, adding @langchain/langgraph@^1.4.14. Both new LangGraph/Anthropic deps resolved cleanly against the versions ADR-14 verified, no peer warnings. Tests build and run the real compiled graph against injected fakes (ragGraph.test.ts, ADR-8, no module mocking): a grounded answer whose prompt provably contains the retrieved chunk text; the no-context path returns RAG.noContextAnswer and asserts the fake chat client is never called (the anti-fabrication guarantee); a chat-provider failure and an embedding failure both surface unwrapped as AppError (LLM_FAILED/EMBEDDING_FAILED), matching ADR-14's verified unwrapped-error behaviour. anthropicChatClient.test.ts separately covers the adapter's own error mapping (initial-call throw and mid-stream throw both become LLM_FAILED without leaking the provider cause) and its message-role mapping. Full suite is 140 tests, green, at the tip of #26 (which already contains every prior PR's commits). llmFailedError carries nothing in AppError's `details` -- checked errorHandler.ts's echo behaviour before writing it, same pattern as embeddingFailedError/embeddingDimensionMismatchError. status.json's E3-T03 entry (code: done, codeReview: pending) is committed in #26 per the fold-bookkeeping-into-the-open-PR rule.
